Rereading or resuming a compacted chat over the session protocol also stops keeping old messages restored by a taken-back turn. If the latest compaction belongs to a taken-back turn, reading is still refused, and calling `view/subscribe` from earlier history returns the same error instead of a cursor that loops in place.

items.original:
Over the session protocol, a reread or resumed compacted chat no longer keeps showing restored earlier messages from a turn that was taken back
Resuming a compacted session whose last turn was taken back now shows the conversation since the last compaction, as the other clients do, instead of replaying the whole log or showing the taken-back turn's summary
`view/subscribe` from earlier history of a session whose latest compaction belonged to a turn that was taken back now refuses with the same error as reading the session, instead of pointing the client at a cursor that gives the same answer again
Resuming or forking a session whose last turn was taken back after it saved a checkpoint without compacting now continues from the previous compaction, instead of refusing the session or replaying the whole log
Resuming a session saved by an older version whose last turn was taken back after it wrote a checkpoint without compacting now continues from the previous compaction instead of refusing the session

title.zh-TW: 檢查點出現缺漏或損毀紀錄時，盡力救回並引導匯出
title.en: Recover what is possible on missing or damaged checkpoint records and guide export

body.zh-TW:
遭遇異常斷線讓壓縮紀錄殘缺不全時，以前常整段對話直接死鎖、一條錯誤訊息卡死再也進不去。傳送或恢復工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）時，不再因「projection failed: tool-result clear entry did not match」而失敗。起因是某筆「tool-result clear」清理紀錄找不到對應結果，或對應到不只一個結果；程式現在會略過壞掉的那筆，保留舊輸出繼續。

壓縮中途斷掉留下一大疊殘餘紀錄，重開時也不再因此失敗；若檢查點上方有紀錄遺失，恢復後會把權限重設回預設值並跳出警告，讓你仍能打開對話而非被鎖在門外。唯一例外是當最新檢查點屬於已取消的回合時，為免錯載更早歷史，程式會明確拒絕恢復、讀取或分支，並引導改用 `muse export` 救回日誌。
body.en:
When an unexpected disconnect left compaction records incomplete, a whole chat used to deadlock behind a single error. Sending or resuming a session no longer fails with "projection failed: tool-result clear entry did not match". This happened when a "tool-result clear" cleanup entry matched no result or more than one; the app now skips the broken entry and keeps going with the old output left in place.

Reopening after an interrupted compaction with large leftover records no longer fails either. If a record above a checkpoint is lost, resuming resets permissions to defaults and shows a warning so you can still open the chat instead of being locked out. The only exception is when the newest checkpoint belongs to a cancelled turn: to avoid reloading earlier history by mistake, resuming, reading, or forking is refused with a clear error guiding you to recover the log with `muse export`.

items.original:
A chat whose newest compaction checkpoint belongs to a cancelled turn now refuses to resume, read, or fork with a clear error instead of reloading history from before the checkpoint; use `muse export` to recover its log
Sending or resuming a session no longer fails with "projection failed: tool-result clear entry did not match" when a stored clear record matches no result or matches more than one; the bad entry is skipped and the session continues with the old output left in context
Resuming a chat with a lost record above a checkpoint reopens with permissions reset to defaults and a warning instead of refusing
Resuming a session after an interrupted compaction no longer fails when the leftover compaction records are large

title.zh-TW: 壓縮對話重開後保留圖片提問且不重跑舊佇列
title.en: Keep image prompts and avoid re-running old queued messages after reopening compacted chats

body.zh-TW: 以前在壓縮過的對話裡重開視窗或貼上截圖繼續問問題，常發生兩個意外：要嘛已經跑完的排隊舊訊息莫名再執行一次，要嘛剛發的圖片提問剛好撞上回合開頭壓縮而被丟掉，結果代理跑去回答上一題。現在重開壓縮工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）後，已完成的排隊訊息不會再重跑；夾帶圖片的提問在回合開頭觸發壓縮時也不會遺失，代理會確實回答該張圖片的問題。重開後才補送的圖片提問，在下次再重開時亦能繼續留在模型上下文裡並支援 `/compact`，只是暫時還不能倒帶或從該回合開分支。
body.en: Reopening a compacted chat or pasting a screenshot to ask a follow-up used to cause two surprises: completed queued messages would run again, or a new image prompt would be dropped when compaction hit at the start of its turn, leaving the agent to answer the previous question. Now, reopening a compacted session no longer re-runs completed queued messages, and an image prompt is no longer lost when compaction triggers at the start of its turn, so the agent answers that image prompt. An image prompt sent after reopening also stays in the model's context on the next reopen and supports `/compact`, though you cannot yet rewind to that turn or fork from it.

items.original:
Reopening a compacted conversation no longer runs completed queued messages again
In a compacted session, an image prompt that you send after you reopen the session now stays in the model's context after the next reopen, and `/compact` works again in that session; you cannot yet rewind to that turn or fork from it
A prompt with an image is no longer dropped when the context is compacted at the start of its turn, so the agent answers that prompt instead of the previous one

title.zh-TW: 修好分支對話重開、檢查點起跑與卡片顯示
title.en: Fix forked chat reopening, checkpoint startup, and card display

body.zh-TW:
把一段長對話開出分支或側邊討論來做實驗，以前重開分支後常得每輪重讀全部歷史，遇上舊紀錄破損、日誌重播錯誤或 "invalid_target" 就整支打不開，甚至要退出時還跳出還有工作在跑的假警告。現在分支本身壓縮過後，重開與再開子分支／側邊對話都會直接從最新檢查點起跑而不受舊紀錄損傷阻礙；補追存過檢查點的對話開分支與側邊對話也不再報 "invalid_target"。

恢復分支工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）時，日誌重播錯誤與退出時的假工作警告都已消除，先前執行過的指令也會維持收合整齊的「Ran commands」卡片，不再炸出整頁原始輸出。
body.en:
When branching a long chat or opening a side chat to experiment, reopening a fork used to re-read its entire history on every turn, failing to open on damaged older records, log-replay errors, or "invalid_target", or even showing a false active-work warning on quit. Now, once a fork has compacted, reopening it or starting a sub-fork or side chat from it starts directly from its newest checkpoint without being blocked by older damage. Forking or opening a side chat from a session that saved a checkpoint while catching up also no longer fails with "invalid_target".

Resuming a forked session eliminates those log-replay errors and false active-work warnings on quit, and previously run commands stay grouped in the neat "Ran commands" card instead of dumping raw output across the page.

items.original:
A fork reopened after it compacted no longer re-reads its whole history each turn, so damage in older history no longer stops it
Resuming a forked session no longer sometimes fails with a log-replay error that forced a recovery session instead
Resumed forked sessions keep the grouped Ran commands card instead of expanded raw output
A fork or side chat of a fork that has compacted starts from that fork's newest checkpoint instead of re-reading its whole history
Forking a session, or opening a side chat from it, no longer fails with "invalid_target" when the session compacted and later saved a checkpoint while catching up
Avoid a false active work warning when quitting a resumed fork

title.zh-TW: 分支建立前先驗種子合法性並補全複製訊息
title.en: Validate fork seeds before creation and restore missing copied messages

body.zh-TW:
先前剛壓縮完、還沒發新訊息就急著開分支，常因為檢查點計算方式落差被誤判為種子數量不符，或者好不容易開出一個分支卻怎麼都打不開。現在檢查點夾帶的分支種子與接續壓縮對話的乾淨分支，都已對齊重播規則，不再無故被拒；分支或側邊對話剛壓縮完、尚未送出下一則訊息時，再從它開分支也不再出現種子數量不符。

反過來說，如果原對話裡藏著沒記到開頭的空回合，或生成的種子在其他地方無法載入，建立分支當下就會直接攔下並說明原因，不會先建好才讓你打不開。透過工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）協定讀取分支或倒帶對話時，一回合開頭連發的多則訊息、夾圖片訊息與回合進行中補送的訊息也全數補回顯示。
body.en:
Forking right after compaction before sending a new message used to fail with a fork seed count mismatch due to checkpoint counting differences, or produce a fork that refused to open. Checkpoint-carried fork seeds and clean successor forks of compacted chats are now aligned with replay rules and no longer rejected without cause. Branching from a forked or side chat right after it compacts, before its next message, also no longer triggers a seed count mismatch.

Conversely, if the original chat contains an empty turn whose start was never recorded, or a seed that would fail to load elsewhere, fork creation now stops immediately and explains why instead of creating an unopenable fork. Reading a forked or rewound chat over the session protocol also restores all previously missing messages in copied turns: multiple messages sent at the start of a turn, messages with images, and messages sent while the original turn was still running.

items.original:
Checkpoint-carried fork seeds the loader must accept are no longer refused as mismatched: covered turns and carrier children count the way the replay mints them
A clean successor fork of a compacted session (its summary flattened ahead of the model's answer) is no longer counted as a mismatched seed: the answered summary is its context run, not a turn
Reading a forked or rewound conversation over the session protocol now shows the messages you sent in its copied turns that were missing before: each message of a turn that began with several, a message with an image, and a message you sent while the original turn was still working
Forking a chat that contains an empty turn whose start was not recorded is now refused with a message saying why, instead of creating a fork that fails to open
A fork whose seed would fail to load elsewhere is now refused at creation with a clear error instead of publishing and then failing to open
Branching a forked or side session right after it compacts, before its next message, no longer fails with a fork seed count mismatch

title.zh-TW: /rewind 倒帶確認加上立即回饋與窄視窗防誤按
title.en: Add instant feedback and short-terminal safeguards to /rewind confirmation

body.zh-TW: 在比較矮小的終端機視窗按 `/rewind` 確認倒帶時，過去在伺服器還沒回話前畫面看似毫無動靜，選項太擠看不見甚至按 Enter 就糊裡糊塗送出了。⟦就跟按下行車記錄器的回溯鍵一樣，面板立刻亮起「準備中」，選項不再顯示選取反白，視窗太矮還會提醒拉高，不再對著靜止畫面誤按。⟧現在確認倒帶會馬上顯示「Preparing rewind…」並取消選項反白。準備期間按下 `Ctrl-D` 或自訂離開鍵也能觸發「press again to quit」提示，若有任務仍在跑則彈出退出確認，選 Stay 或 Esc 可退回倒帶畫面。短視窗下一定會留住警告與所選動作並擋下畫不出的隱藏選項確認，太矮則請你拉高；若倒帶啟動前遭拒，畫面也會清楚寫明原因而不靜默跳回選單。
body.en: Confirming `/rewind` in a short terminal window used to leave the screen looking frozen before the server answered, hiding cramped options or even confirming unseen ones on Enter. ⟦Pressing a dashcam's rewind button lights up a "preparing" indicator right away, clears the row highlights, and asks you to make the screen taller if it is too short, so you never confirm blindly on a static menu.⟧ Confirming a rewind now shows "Preparing rewind…" immediately and clears the row selection. While it prepares, pressing `Ctrl-D` or your remapped exit key triggers the "press again to quit" hint, and if work is still running, the exit confirmation appears where Stay or Esc returns to the rewind screen. Short terminals always keep the warnings and selected action visible while blocking Enter on hidden actions, or ask you to make the window taller if nothing fits; if a rewind is refused before starting, the screen explains why instead of silently returning to the menu.

items.original:
Confirming a conversation rewind now shows "Preparing rewind…" right away, and the action rows stop showing a selection, so it is clear the rewind is underway before the server answers
In a short terminal, the rewind confirmation keeps its warnings and the selected action on screen, Enter no longer confirms an action the screen could not show, and a terminal too short for any action asks you to make it taller
While a confirmed conversation rewind is preparing, the exit key (Ctrl-D, or your remapped exit binding) works again: the first press shows the "press again to quit" hint on the rewind screen, and when work is still running the exit confirmation appears and Stay or Esc returns to the rewind
When a conversation rewind is refused before it starts (the command queue is full or closed, the request fails, or the server rejects it), the rewind screen now shows why instead of returning to its choices with no message

title.zh-TW: 分支對話支援倒帶，並釐清壓縮邊界與讀圖失敗提示
title.en: Support /rewind in forked chats and clarify compaction boundaries and image-read errors

body.zh-TW:
在從主線切出來的分支對話裡想用 `/rewind` 回到某一步時，過去常碰上不支援的限制，或是碰到舊對話壓縮點、壞圖檔時看到誤導人的選項與提示。現在分支對話已經正式支援倒帶，無論是要退回從原對話複製過來的訊息，還是分支之後新加進去的訊息都能照常操作。

在摘要無法作為分支起點的舊版工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）中，`/rewind` 不再列出壓縮摘要之前的時間點，摘要之後的點則標為無法使用；若要倒帶的回合裡夾帶了一張無法讀取的貼上圖片，程式也會明確提示圖片讀不到且可重試，不再誤報為「對話已經變更」。
body.en:
Using `/rewind` inside a forked chat used to hit unsupported limits or show misleading options and errors around old compaction points or broken images. Rewind now works in forked conversations for both messages copied from the original chat and new messages added after the fork.

In older sessions whose summary cannot start a branch, `/rewind` no longer offers points from before the compacted summary, and points after it are shown as unavailable. When rewinding to a turn with an unreadable pasted image, the app now clearly states that the image could not be read and that you can retry, instead of falsely reporting that the conversation changed.

items.original:
`/rewind` no longer offers points from before a compacted summary in older sessions whose summary cannot start a branch; the points after it are shown as unavailable instead
Rewind works in forked conversations, including copied messages and new messages added after the fork
Rewinding to a turn whose pasted image can't be read now says the image couldn't be read and that you can retry, instead of saying the conversation changed

title.zh-TW: 終端機支援自動切換深淺主題與更寬的比較表格
title.en: Support automatic light-dark terminal themes and wider comparison tables

body.zh-TW: 盯著終端機從白天寫到黑夜，以前切了系統背景顏色介面卻不動，白底文字偏淡，多項數字還硬拆成窄表。⟦猶如隨屋外陽光自動調色的變色眼鏡，終端機切換深淺色時介面不用重開就同步換裝，白底上的字跡與框線也跟著加深。⟧在 Ghostty、kitty 與 Contour 等終端機裡，除非於 `/theme` 固定背景，否則主題會即時同步，預設淺色主題亦調深次要、成功、警告、強調與邊框色彩。比較多筆短數字時改為單張寬表格。輸入 `/hud` 可於底部狀態列顯示與 `/status` 相同的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）ID。在恢復對話的選單裡按 `ctrl+o` 進舒適檢視時，會點名工作區未信任、探測沙盒不可用或檢查失敗等狀態缺席原因。預設的緊湊檢視不變。新 TUI 亦補回「You're using your quota fast」額度提醒。
body.en: Coding in a terminal from day into night used to leave the UI static when your system background changed, with pale text on white and multi-item numbers split into narrow tables. ⟦Photochromic lenses tint automatically with outdoor sunlight; here, the UI switches themes live as your terminal changes between light and dark without a restart, while text and borders on white grow darker.⟧ In terminals such as Ghostty, kitty, and Contour, the theme now syncs live unless you pin a fixed background in `/theme`, and the Default Light theme darkens secondary, success, warning, accent, and stroke colors. Comparing multiple short numbers now renders in one wider table. Running `/hud` shows the same session ID in the bottom status bar as `/status`. Pressing `ctrl+o` for the comfortable view in the resume picker now names why workspace status is unavailable—such as an untrusted workspace, unavailable probe sandbox, or failed check—while the default dense view stays unchanged. The new TUI client also restores the "You're using your quota fast" quota prompt.

items.original:
`/hud` can show the current session ID in the bottom status bar, the same ID `/status` reports
The resume picker's comfortable view (`ctrl+o`) now explains why workspace status is unavailable — whether the workspace is not trusted, the probe sandbox is unavailable, or the status check failed — instead of silently omitting it; the default dense view is unchanged
When an answer compares many items on short numbers, such as estimates for several funds under several scenarios, Muse can now show them in one wider table that still fits a normal terminal instead of splitting them into narrow tables
The terminal UI now switches between light and dark themes when your terminal does, while a session is running, in terminals that report it (such as Ghostty, kitty and Contour), unless you set a fixed light or dark terminal background in `/theme`
Default Light theme: darker secondary, success, warning, accent and stroke colors for readable contrast on white
The quota pace offer ("You're using your quota fast") now appears in sessions on the new TUI client just as in classic sessions, instead of never showing

title.zh-TW: 修復終端機字元亂碼、引文程式碼框與焦點重繪
title.en: Fix terminal character garbling, quoted code blocks, and focus redraw

body.zh-TW:
在舊版 Windows 主控台（例如純 PowerShell 視窗）或切去別的軟體再點回終端機時，以前常看到問號方框或花掉的畫面留在原地。現在傳統 Windows 主控台的提示與狀態符號都能正常顯示，終端機重新取得焦點時也會重繪對話區，讓錯亂的畫面立刻恢復。

文字排版與路徑顯示也一併修正：引言區塊裡的程式碼方塊會保留縮排與語法高亮，且不再印出圍欄符號；`/rules` 裡含有單引號的檔案路徑顯示正確；標籤本身就是絕對路徑的檔案連結，在對話紀錄裡會完整秀出絕對路徑而不被縮短；輸出緩慢送達而被截斷的 shell 結果，總大小計算亦恢復精準。
body.en:
In the classic Windows console (such as a plain PowerShell window) or when switching back from another app, question-mark boxes or garbled frames used to linger on screen. Prompt and status symbols now render properly in the classic Windows console, and the terminal redraws the chat area when regaining focus so a broken frame recovers right away.

Text layout and path display are fixed as well: code blocks inside quotes keep their indentation and syntax highlighting without printing fence lines, file paths with apostrophes display properly in `/rules`, file links whose label is their own absolute path show that full path in the transcript instead of shortening it, and truncated shell output that arrives slowly reports its accurate total size.

items.original:
In the classic Windows console, such as a plain PowerShell window, the prompt and status symbols now show as readable characters instead of boxes with question marks
The terminal now redraws the chat area when its window regains focus, so a garbled frame recovers instead of staying broken
A file link whose label is its own absolute path now shows that absolute path in the TUI transcript instead of shortening it to a workspace-relative path, so asking for a file's full path gets the full path
File paths with apostrophes display correctly in `/rules`
Code blocks inside quotes keep their indentation and highlighting, and their fence lines no longer show
Truncated shell output keeps its correct total size when output arrives slowly

title.zh-TW: 輸入框保留草稿、支援運行中回捲與 Cmd+V 貼圖
title.en: Keep input drafts, scroll while running, and paste screenshots with Cmd+V

body.zh-TW:
字打到一半按上鍵想翻找前面問過的句子來改，以前整段辛苦打好的草稿直接飛走；想在 VS Code 或 Cursor 裡按 Cmd+V 貼截圖也沒反應。現在編輯按上鍵叫出的歷史提示時，旁邊會顯示 `· edited`，按 Esc 或下鍵就能把還沒送出的原草稿叫回來；macOS 用戶在發送空白貼上訊號的終端機裡按 Cmd+V 也可順利附上截圖。

工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）執行期間用滑鼠滾輪或觸控板回捲歷史已恢復正常，點擊輸入框不再跳移游標。當機重啟後，當機前排隊的訊息會照送出順序各跑一次再輪到新訊息，訊息更新失敗時佇列輸入面板也不再誤報「your input still works」。
body.en:
Pressing Up mid-sentence to look for an earlier prompt to edit used to wipe out the entire draft you had been typing, and pressing Cmd+V to paste a screenshot in VS Code or Cursor did nothing. Now, when you edit a historical prompt recalled with Up, `· edited` appears next to it, and pressing Esc or Down brings back your unsent original draft; on macOS, pressing Cmd+V in terminals that send an empty paste signal also attaches screenshots cleanly.

Scrolling back through history with a mouse wheel or trackpad works again while a session (the execution unit of an AI conversation) is running, and clicking the input box no longer jumps the cursor. After a crash restart, messages queued before the crash run once each in the order they were sent before your new message runs, and the queued input panel no longer falsely reports "your input still works" when message updates fail.

items.original:
Typing into a prompt you recalled with Up no longer throws away the message you were writing; the recalled prompt shows `· edited` next to its history position, and Down or Esc brings your unsent message back
Scrolling back through earlier output with the mouse wheel or trackpad works again while a session runs; clicking in the input no longer moves the cursor
On macOS, pasting a screenshot with Cmd+V now attaches it in terminals that send an empty paste for images, such as VS Code and Cursor
After Muse Code restarts from a crash, messages you queued before the crash now run before your next message, once each and in the order you sent them; before, your new message ran first
The queued input panel no longer says "your input still works" when message updates fail

title.zh-TW: 終端機程式狀態準確顯示運作與待答，計畫列不遮狀態
title.en: Accurate terminal program status for working and waiting, with unblocked plan rows

body.zh-TW: 如果你用的是支援顯示程式狀態（OSC 7501）的終端機，以前在壓縮對話、跑排程、整理回顧或剛被背景任務叫醒時，程式狀態卻還顯示已完成，代理打字問你問題時也看不出它在等你回話。⟦就像錄音室門外的燈號必須照真實狀況亮起，「作業中」與「等嘉賓回答」分得清清楚楚，房間變窄時儀表燈也不會被牆板擋住。⟧現在不論是背景喚醒、排程、上下文壓縮、啟動回合或產生回顧期間，都會正確顯示運作中；若回合以純文字提問作結，即便發生在訊息確認前的快速回合，也會立刻亮成等待你回覆。在較矮的終端機執行回合時，計畫面板還會自動摺疊成較少列數，留住開啟 HUD token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）欄位時的即時用量列。
body.en: If you use a terminal that supports showing program status (OSC 7501), compacting a conversation, running a schedule, generating a recap, or waking from a background task used to leave the status stuck on done, and when the agent typed a question there was no sign it was waiting for your reply. ⟦Indicator lights outside a recording studio have to match what is really happening, clearly separating "working" from "waiting for the guest's answer," without letting wall panels block the meter lights when the room gets narrow.⟧ Now the status accurately shows working during background wakes, schedules, context compaction, turn starts, and recap generation; if a turn ends with a plain-text question, even in a quick turn before your message is confirmed, it immediately switches to waiting for your reply. When running a turn in a shorter terminal, the plan panel also folds to fewer rows automatically so the live usage row stays visible when the HUD token (the text unit AI processes and bills by) field is enabled.

items.original:
On a short terminal during a running turn, the plan panel now folds to fewer rows instead of pushing the live status row (token use, when the HUD tokens field is on) out of view, so the current plan and token use stay visible together
Terminals that show program status (OSC 7501) now see Muse as working while a turn started by a finished background task, a schedule, or another wake runs, instead of keeping the previous turn's done or idle state
Terminals that show program status (OSC 7501) now see Muse as working while it compacts context, starts a turn, or generates a recap you asked for, instead of the previous turn's done or idle state
Terminals that show program status (OSC 7501) now see Muse as waiting for you when a turn ends by asking a question in plain text, instead of done
Terminals that show program status (OSC 7501) now see Muse as waiting for you when a quick turn ends on a plain-text question before Muse confirms your message, instead of done

title.zh-TW: 窄窗保留對話末行、Hook 通知不洗版並互通舊版紀錄
title.en: Keep the last line in short panes, stop hook spam, and share older history

body.zh-TW:
把終端機窗格縮到只剩 5 或 6 列高時，以前回合一結束畫面看起來就像全空白，對話紀錄也常被各種 hook（特定事件觸發的小程式）訊息洗版，或是桌面版看不到終端機上還開著的舊對話的歷史，只顯示空白。現在就算在只有 5、6 列的窄窗格裡，助手回覆與對話最後一行也會緊貼在輸入區上方顯示而不像剛開的新工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）。

hook 訊息不再塞進對話紀錄列，改為簡短的狀態通知，右下角顯示重要阻擋、失敗或逾時警告的 5 秒內，其他 hook 訊息也不會將它蓋掉。桌面版現在能正常讀取終端機上 Muse Code 1.4.9 至 1.4.14 仍開啟中的對話歷史；由舊版佔用的 `muse serve` 對話即使日誌曾有無法讀取的區段，仍可顯示已存歷史。
body.en:
When you shrank a terminal pane to just 5 or 6 rows tall, the screen used to look completely blank once a turn ended, transcripts were often flooded with hook (a small program triggered by specific events) messages, and the desktop app showed nothing for older conversations still open in a terminal. Now, even in a narrow 5- or 6-row pane, assistant replies and the last line of the conversation stay visible right above the input area instead of looking like a brand-new session.

Hook messages no longer crowd the transcript rows and instead appear as brief status notices, and for 5 seconds while an important block, failure, or timeout warning is shown in the lower-right corner, other hook messages will not overwrite it. The desktop app can now properly read the history of conversations still open in a terminal on Muse Code 1.4.9 to 1.4.14, and `muse serve` chats held open by an older version still display their saved history even if the log had an unreadable stretch.

items.original:
Messages from hooks no longer appear as rows in the transcript; they show only as a brief status notice
Assistant replies stay visible in short terminal windows
The desktop app now shows the saved history of a conversation that Muse Code 1.4.9 to 1.4.14 still has open in a terminal, instead of an empty history
In a terminal pane only 5 or 6 rows tall, the end of a turn no longer leaves a blank-looking session: the last line of the conversation stays visible above the typing area, so a session with history no longer looks like a fresh start
During the five seconds that a hook's block, failure or timeout notice shows in the lower-right corner, another hook's message no longer replaces it and is not shown
A `muse serve` chat that an older Muse version still holds open now shows its saved history when its log had an unreadable stretch, instead of showing no history

title.zh-TW: 動手改檔、清資料夾與更新任務前先停步說清楚
title.en: Pause and explain before editing files, cleaning folders, or updating tasks

body.zh-TW:
請 AI 規劃改動、清理目錄或處理共享任務時，最怕它擅自刪過頭或用長篇計畫洗版。⟦想像請師傅來大掃除，他會先列清單問你陌生箱子留不留、遞上計畫便條，等你點頭才真的開工。⟧現在擬完計畫會用白話交代尚未修改任何檔案，提示可回 `go` 開始或告知調整處；要求將計畫存檔時會存在指定或專案顯眼位置，只回傳連結、一行結論與關鍵決策。

清理目錄時會先列清單、只刪任務項目，遇到疑似無關的另一儲存庫、符號連結（捷徑檔）或資料會先詢問，未獲回覆便保留並於結尾交代已刪與待確認項目。你口述的已發生遷移或部署，代理會直接採納、改掉舊預設並在後續回合記住。任務本身的文字或代理提示要求它更新共享任務的狀態、計畫或欄位時，Muse 不會照辦；它先做你要求的事，再問你要不要更新，等你同意才改。
body.en:
When asking AI to plan changes, clean a directory, or handle a shared task, the biggest worry is that it might delete too much on its own or flood chat with a long plan. ⟦Before a cleaning crew starts clearing out a room, they list what is there, ask whether unfamiliar boxes should stay, and hand you a plan note to approve before touching anything.⟧ Now, after drafting a plan, it states in plain words that no files have been modified yet and notes that you can reply `go` to begin or say what to adjust; when asked to save a plan to a file, it saves it at the specified path or a visible spot in the project and replies only with the link, a one-line verdict, and key decisions.

When cleaning a directory, it lists items first and only deletes what belongs to the task, asking before removing anything that looks unrelated such as another repository, a symlink (a shortcut file), or data—keeping those items if you do not answer and noting at the end what was deleted and what awaits confirmation. Migrations or deployments you describe as already done are adopted directly, updating old defaults and sticking in later turns. When a task's own text or agent hints tell Muse to update a shared task's status, plan, or fields, it does not follow those instructions; it does the work you asked for first, then asks whether you want the update and waits for your approval.

items.original:
After a plan, the reply now says in plain words that nothing has changed yet and that you can reply `go` to start or say what to adjust
Muse Code no longer updates a shared task (its status, plan, or fields) just because the task's own text or agent hints tell agents to; it does the work you asked for, then offers the update and waits for your yes
When you ask Muse Code to empty a directory or clean up files, its final answer now names what it removed and flags anything that looked unrelated to the task, such as another repository or a symlink into one
When you ask Muse Code to empty a directory or clean up files, it now lists what is there first, deletes what belongs to the task, and asks before deleting anything that looks unrelated, such as another repository, a symlink into one, or data; without your answer it keeps those items and says so
When you tell Muse Code about something the repository cannot show, such as a migration or a deployment that already happened, it now works from what you said, updates repository defaults that still point at the old setup, and remembers it in later turns instead of asking you to repeat it
When you ask for a plan in a file, the agent now saves it at the path you named (or a visible spot in your project) and replies with the link, a one-line verdict, and the key decisions instead of pasting the whole plan into chat

title.zh-TW: 看懂圖片真實像素尺寸，手機直拍縮圖不再歪斜
title.en: Read true pixel dimensions of images and keep rotated phone thumbnails upright

body.zh-TW:
把螢幕全圖或手機拍的照片丟給 AI 幫忙檢查排版、報出按鈕座標時，以前傳過協定常縮小失敗、方向橫躺，甚至報出對不上的像素座標。⟦好似送相館縮印海報，店員不只先把橫躺的照片轉正，還附註原圖的長寬像素比例，量座標才不會算偏。⟧現在代理讀取圖片檔時，能同時看見圖片的寬高像素以及縮放前的原始尺寸，給出的像素位置與圖片本身一致。

透過工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）協定傳送超過 2048 像素且在 6144 像素以內的高解析圖片，例如全螢幕截圖時，會比照終端機先縮放至 2048 像素內，好讓應用程式顯示縮圖並在倒帶與恢復時保留圖片。超過 2048 像素或 2 MiB 而經縮放重編碼的手機旋轉照片，現在也會乖乖正立不再歪成橫向。
body.en:
When sending a full-screen capture or phone photo to AI to check layout or report button coordinates, passing it over the protocol used to fail resizing, tip it sideways, or produce mismatched pixel coordinates. ⟦A photo lab resizing a poster first turns a sideways shot upright and notes the original width-and-height pixel dimensions so measurements never drift.⟧ Now, when the agent reads an image file, it sees both the image's pixel width and height and its original size before scaling, so the pixel positions it gives match the image itself.

High-resolution images wider or taller than 2048 pixels up to 6144 pixels sent over the session protocol, such as full-screen screenshots, are now resized to fit within 2048 pixels just like in the terminal app, letting apps display thumbnails and preserve images across rewind and resume. Rotated phone photos that get resized or re-encoded because they exceed 2048 pixels or 2 MiB now stay upright instead of turning sideways.

items.original:
When the agent reads an image file, it now also sees the image's width and height in pixels, plus the original size when the image was scaled down, so positions it gives in pixels match the image
An image wider or taller than 2048 pixels, up to 6144, sent over the session protocol, such as a full-screen screenshot, is now resized to fit 2048 pixels before the model sees it, as in the terminal app, so apps can show its thumbnail in the sent prompt and rewind and resume keep the image
A rotated phone photo that is resized or re-encoded before the model sees it, because it is over 2048 pixels or 2 MiB, now stays upright instead of turning sideways

title.zh-TW: 修 Bug 補齊邊界測試並順著實際執行路徑查錯
title.en: Add boundary tests for bug fixes and trace the actual execution path

body.zh-TW:
請 AI 除錯或檢查既有程式時，以前常看到它測試只測剛剛好報錯的那一筆、把原本對的程式碼誤刪，或者你回報改動沒生效時它只檢查設定檔就說沒問題。⟦彷彿修車師傅排查異音，不只檢查零件有沒有裝上去，而是實際沿著車主開過的路段跑一圈，順手把相鄰路況一起測過才交車。⟧現在修 Bug 會為每個回報缺陷補上針對性的失敗測試，連同修正宣稱涵蓋的另一位置或順序、極端邊界值與需求重申規則一起寫進迴歸測試（不另外引進新測試框架或亂跑全套測試）。

核對既有程式只修錯處並說明保留正確行為的原因；回報改動沒出現時改追你實際執行的程式路徑；驗證觀察員也能看到長工具輸出末尾的通過結果，減少重複退回驗證；修正與建置摘要則會把緊密相關的事實串成順暢句子，不再一行一行硬拆。
body.en:
When asking AI to debug or inspect existing code, it used to test only the exact failing input, accidentally delete code that was already right, or stop after checking config files when you reported a change had no effect. ⟦Mechanics tracking down a rattle do not just check whether a part is bolted on—they drive the exact route the owner took and test neighboring road conditions before handing back the keys.⟧ Now bug fixes get a focused failing test for each reported defect, along with regression tests covering another position or order, extreme boundary values, and input rules restated in the request that the fix claims to handle (still without introducing new test frameworks or running the full suite unnecessarily).

When checking existing code, it fixes only what is wrong and explains why correct behavior is kept; when you report that a change does not show up, it traces the code path you actually ran; the verify observer can now see passing results at the end of long tool outputs to reduce needless re-verification; and fix and build summaries weave closely related facts into connected sentences instead of splitting one fact per line.

items.original:
Bug fixes now get a focused failing test for each reported defect, and the regression test also covers the inputs the fix claims to handle beyond the reported one (another position or order, extreme or boundary values, and input rules the request restates), still without new test frameworks or extra full-suite runs
When you ask whether something already built behaves correctly, the agent now checks each observation against the source the project follows, fixes only what is wrong, and keeps behavior that is correct, explaining why instead of removing it
Muse Code keeps closely linked facts in one sentence, so fix and build summaries read as connected sentences instead of one fact per line
When the verify observer reviews a finished turn, it can now see the end of a long tool result, where a check usually prints whether it passed, as well as the result's start — so a task that already passed its check is less likely to be sent to verify again
When you report that a change does not show up in your own run, the agent is now prompted to trace the code path you ran instead of stopping at setup or flag steps

title.zh-TW: 加快 3D 網頁與瀏覽器遊戲開發自測流程
title.en: Speed up self-testing for 3D web pages and browser games

body.zh-TW: 用一兩句話請 Muse 試寫互動立體頁面，或丟給它長篇企劃做網頁小遊戲時，以前就算需求很單純也得跑完多輪審查，本機沒裝檢視工具更會直接跳過驗證。⟦好比做小遊戲不等美術貼圖全畫完才試玩，引擎能動就先讓試玩員測手感，兩組評審再同步測同一版加快打磨。⟧現在碰到電腦缺少瀏覽器時，Muse 會改用系統套件管理員安裝無頭瀏覽器（沒有視覺介面的執行模式）親自檢查 3D 網頁，只有安裝失敗才明講未能執行。一兩句的簡短 3D 網頁需求則改走單輪輕量檢查，包含桌機執行、單項輸入測試、修正與最終驗證，寫得詳盡的需求仍會走完全部檢查。內建 `browser-game` 技能也提前讓首位評審在美術進場前先試玩，第二與第三輪評審則同時開測同一份副本。
body.en: When asking Muse in a sentence or two to prototype an interactive 3D page or handing it a long design document for a browser mini-game, even simple requests used to go through multiple review rounds, and missing local viewing tools caused it to skip verification altogether. ⟦Game studios testing a prototype do not wait for every art texture to be finished before playtesting—once the engine runs, they let a tester check the feel and have two review rounds test the same build in parallel to polish it faster.⟧ Now, when a machine has no browser, Muse installs a headless browser (a mode that runs without a visual interface) via the system package manager to inspect the 3D page itself, stating plainly that it could not run only if that install fails. Short one- or two-sentence 3D web requests take a single light pass covering a desktop run, one input test, a fix, and a final check, while detailed briefs still go through every check. The built-in `browser-game` skill also lets the first critic playtest as soon as the game runs before art is added, while the second and third critic rounds test the same copy simultaneously.

items.original:
When you ask for a 3D web page and the machine has no browser, Muse now installs a headless browser with the system package manager to check the page itself, and says plainly that the page was not run only if that install fails
When you ask for a 3D web page in a sentence or two, Muse now checks it in one light pass (a desktop run, one input test, a fix and a final run) instead of its full review rounds, so short requests finish sooner; detailed briefs still get every check
The built-in `browser-game` skill finishes games built from long design documents faster: the first critic plays the game as soon as it runs, before the art is in, and the second and third critic rounds play the same copy at the same time

title.zh-TW: 打開自建網頁或遊戲時直接給明路徑與啟動指令
title.en: Give direct paths and start commands when opening built pages or games

body.zh-TW: 網頁或瀏覽器小遊戲寫好想在自己電腦打開看效果時，以前常遇到代理反問你要怎麼辦、口頭答應會幫你顧著伺服器卻在退出時跟著熄火，甚至偷偷在背景多開一個你看不到的伺服器。⟦如同木工做好攤車後把地址與啟動紙條遞給你，老實說明下班就會熄火，既不偷點暗火也不亂承諾看顧。⟧現在於遠端機器做完瀏覽器遊戲，Muse 會直接附上可從自己電腦打開的本機網址與 SSH 通道指令；在 Mac 上要頁面連結時也會立刻交出檔案路徑或啟動指令、不回頭偷啟隱藏背景伺服器。如果請它讓伺服器長駐運作，它也會直說退出後無法繼續維持並給出自行啟動的指令，若當場啟了伺服器則明講隨 Muse 退出而停。
body.en: When a web page or browser mini-game was ready to view on your own computer, the agent used to ask what you wanted to do, promise to keep a server running only to shut it down on exit, or secretly spin up a hidden background server. ⟦Carpenters finishing a market cart hand you the address and startup slip, state honestly that the lights go out when they clock off, and neither light a hidden fire nor promise to watch over it.⟧ Now, after building a browser game on a remote machine, Muse hands off a local URL you can open from your own computer along with an SSH tunnel command; on a Mac, asking for a page link immediately gives the file path or start command without going back to start a hidden background server. If you ask it to keep a server running, it says plainly that it cannot keep it alive after quitting and provides the command to start it yourself, and if it starts a server on the spot, it notes clearly that the server stops when Muse quits.

items.original:
A browser game built on a remote machine now hands off an SSH tunnel command with its local URL, so you can open it from your own computer
On a Mac, when you ask for a link to a page Muse built, Muse now gives the file path or the start command right away instead of asking what to do, and says plainly when a server it started stops as Muse quits
On a Mac, after Muse hands you a file path or a start command for a page, Muse no longer goes back to start a hidden background server for it
On a Mac, when you ask Muse to keep a server running, Muse now says it cannot keep it running after it quits and gives the command to start it, instead of promising to look after it

title.zh-TW: Windows 編輯保留 CRLF 換行並改寫 PowerShell 指令
title.en: Keep CRLF line endings in Windows edits and rewrite PowerShell commands

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 開發最煩人的兩件事，就是 AI 動不動吐出 PowerShell 根本看不懂的 `grep` 與 `export`，以及改完檔案順手把換行符號全洗成 Unix 格式弄出一堆無意義差異。⟦彷彿修補一本原本用線裝直排印製的古書，師傅不會擅自換成橫排膠裝，在當地問路也改講當地慣用的路標名稱。⟧現在在 Windows 上，Muse 會引導代理改寫 `Select-String` 與 `$env:NAME = ...` 等道地 PowerShell 指令。讀取採用 Windows（CRLF）換行格式的檔案時也會主動提醒代理別改掉換行格式；直接編輯 CRLF 檔案時，一般換行寫法也能正確比對多行文字並在替換後維持 CRLF，若只差在換行格式導致失敗也會明確點出原因。
body.en: Two of the most frustrating parts of developing on Windows are AI spitting out `grep` and `export` commands that PowerShell does not understand, and rewriting all line endings to Unix format after an edit to create piles of noisy diffs. ⟦Bookbinders repairing a thread-stitched vertical volume do not arbitrarily rebind it as a horizontal paperback, and when asking for directions locally they use the local landmark names.⟧ Now on Windows, Muse guides the agent to write native PowerShell commands such as `Select-String` and `$env:NAME = ...`. When reading a file with Windows (CRLF) line endings, it also reminds the agent not to switch the line endings; when editing CRLF files directly, plain line breaks match multi-line text properly and preserve CRLF in the replacement, and if an edit fails only because of line endings, it says so clearly.

items.original:
When the agent reads a file with Windows (CRLF) line endings, it is told so, which makes it less likely to switch the line endings when it rewrites the file
On Windows, the agent is guided to write PowerShell commands such as `Select-String` and `$env:NAME = ...` instead of Unix commands such as `grep` and `export`, which PowerShell does not have
File edits in Windows-style (CRLF) files now match multi-line text written with plain line breaks and keep the file's CRLF line endings in the replacement; a failed edit says when only the line endings differ

title.zh-TW: 緊扣你的要求回答，不縮水需求、不夾雜外語也不硬繞禁令
title.en: Follow requests closely without shrinking scope, mixing languages, or bypassing blocks

body.zh-TW: 用 AI 幫手最怕中途補一句它就停工、叫它簡化它卻只隱藏，或講到一半突然夾雜外語。⟦宛如依清單採買的助手，先直答問題、遇本人驗證關卡立刻通報，絕不私自縮水規格也不改講另一國語言。⟧現在 Muse 會先答直接提問、中途收訊不中斷、未改完不收手、逢本人登入卡關即刻求助，不再硬繞受阻下載或憑證失敗的套件索引，要簡化時真刪不隱藏。釐清提問的推薦選項維持完整範圍，已定案就直接執行；被中斷的未答提問會再問清楚才往下做。進度夾帶異種文字會重試一次；英文工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）的進度說明與工具文字誤切法文、西班牙文或印尼文，也會重新採樣。若提醒讓回合在回答後繼續思考時按 Esc 中止，回答下方會顯示 Interrupted。
body.en: The biggest headaches with an AI assistant are having it stop when you send a mid-task note, hide things when you ask it to simplify, or suddenly switch languages mid-sentence. ⟦Personal shoppers working from a checklist answer direct questions first, report immediately when they hit a gate that requires your own ID, and never quietly downsize the order or switch to another language.⟧ Now Muse answers direct questions first, keeps working when you send a message mid-task, does not stop while requested changes remain unmade, asks for help right away when blocked by a login only you can complete, stops working around blocked downloads or package indexes that fail certificate checks, and actually removes extras instead of hiding them when asked to simplify. The recommended option in clarifying questions keeps the full scope, and requests with settled outcomes proceed directly; interrupted unanswered questions are asked again before building on them. Progress text that switches into another script is retried once, and commentary or tool text that flips into French, Spanish, or Indonesian during English sessions is resampled as well. If a reminder keeps a turn thinking after its answer and you press Esc to stop it, Interrupted appears under the answer.

items.original:
Muse follows your requests more closely: it answers a direct question first, keeps working when you send a question or remark mid-task, does not stop while a change you asked for is still unmade, asks its remaining questions before building on a partial answer, removes extras instead of hiding them when you ask it to simplify, asks you at once when a login only you can renew blocks the task, and no longer works around a download the environment blocks or a package index that fails its certificate check
Replies that switch into another script (such as Chinese characters) mid-task are now retried once so progress text stays in your language
Commentary and tool text that flips into French, Spanish, or Indonesian during an English session is now resampled like foreign-script flips
When you dismiss or interrupt a question prompt, the agent now treats the unanswered questions as still open and asks about them again before building on them
When Muse asks a clarifying question, the recommended option now keeps the full scope you asked for instead of offering a reduced or skeleton variant, and on a request that already settles the outcome it proceeds without stopping to ask
When a reminder such as a goal keeps a turn going after its answer and you press Esc while Muse is thinking again, the answer now shows Interrupted under it

title.zh-TW: 技能工具名稱與目錄排序對齊，自訂記憶子代理不中斷
title.en: Align Skill Tool Names and Catalog Priority, Keep Memory Subagents Running

body.zh-TW:
裝了一大堆擴充技能或用自訂代理跑長任務時，以前常因為工具名字對不上而呼叫錯對象，或者技能提醒硬把代理導去另一個重複功能的技能。現在無論是用斜線指令啟動的內建技能（在終端機包含 `--no-session-log` 的所有工作階段皆適用），還是由自訂代理預先載入的內建技能，裡面的工具名稱都會對齊當下提供給模型的名稱。

當安裝的技能多到目錄裝不下時，內建技能與提示中點名的技能會優先保留完整說明，讓出其餘技能的空間；若已載入的技能已涵蓋同一步驟，技能提醒也不再硬導向別的技能。定義中宣告了記憶功能的子代理也不再中途因記憶錯誤停擺，歷史壓縮時更會保存上下文好讓重開維持流暢。
body.en:
When you have many extension skills installed or run long tasks with custom agents, mismatched tool names used to cause calls to the wrong target, or skill reminders would push an agent toward another skill with overlapping functionality. Now, whether a built-in skill is started with a slash command (including every session in the terminal app started with `--no-session-log`) or preloaded by a custom agent, the tool names inside it match the names currently offered to the model.

When more skills are installed than the catalog can fit, built-in skills and skills named in the prompt keep their full descriptions first while other skills are trimmed to make room, and skill reminders no longer steer the agent to a different skill if an already loaded skill covers the same step. A subagent whose definition declares memory also no longer stalls partway through with a memory error, and it saves its context during history compaction so reopening it stays smooth.

items.original:
When more skills are installed than the skills catalog can list, built-in and prompt-named skills keep their full descriptions first and more of the other skills are left out to make room
Built-in skills you start with a slash command now name tools the way the model is offered them, so it calls them by the right name (not yet with `--no-session-log`)
Built-in skills that a custom agent preloads now name tools the way that agent's model is offered them, so it calls them by the right name
Built-in skills you start with a slash command in the terminal app now name tools the way the model is offered them in every session, including ones started with `--no-session-log`
A subagent whose definition declares memory no longer stops with a memory error partway through its work, and it now saves its context when its history is compacted, so reopening it stays fast
Skill reminders no longer steer the agent onto a different skill when a skill it already loaded covers the same step

title.zh-TW: 長對話送訊加速、遵從目錄限制並正確載入 worktree 設定
title.en: Faster Long-Chat Sends, Folder Boundaries, and Accurate Worktree Config Loading

body.zh-TW:
在裝了許多技能的長對話裡按 Enter 送出訊息，或開著 worktree（讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）實驗改動時，以前每次發問前總要卡一陣子，建議待辦也常跟最新要求唱反調。⟦換成在分店廚房做菜，廚師不只盯緊最新點單，食材與食譜也只從這間分店的架上拿，不再跑回總店或往走廊亂放東西。⟧現在長對話送訊前的前置準備不再按已裝技能數重複執行，按下 Enter 後能以接近新對話的速度送出；長回合中的技能、記憶與待辦建議也會盯緊你的最新指令，不再明明只要你解釋卻建議跑測試。

要求代理待在指定資料夾內工作時，它會把一次性測試腳本留在該處而不再寫去 `/tmp`。在 worktree 工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）裡，Muse 會改從副本本身載入專案技能與規則。連同當地的 hook（特定事件觸發的小程式）與技能檔案也都能順利讀取生效。
body.en:
When you press Enter to send a message in a long chat with many skills installed, or experiment with changes in a worktree (a feature for opening multiple parallel copies of the same project), sending each prompt used to stall for a while and to-do suggestions often contradicted your latest request. ⟦Cooking in a branch kitchen works the same way: the chef watches only the latest ticket and pulls ingredients and recipes strictly from that branch's shelves instead of running back to headquarters or leaving things in the hallway.⟧ Now the setup work before each message in a long chat no longer repeats for every installed skill, so pressing Enter sends nearly as fast as a fresh chat, and skill, memory, and to-do suggestions in long turns stay aligned with your latest instruction instead of suggesting tests when you only asked for an explanation.

When you tell the agent to stay inside a designated folder, it keeps its throwaway test scripts there instead of writing them to `/tmp`. In a worktree session, Muse loads project skills and rules from the copy itself. Local hooks (small programs triggered by specific events) and skill files there also load and take effect properly.

items.original:
In long turns, skill, memory and to-do suggestions now still see your latest request, so a suggestion no longer contradicts it, such as adding tests when you only asked for an explanation
When you tell the agent to stay inside one folder, it keeps its throwaway test scripts there instead of writing them under `/tmp`
Worktree sessions load project skills, rules and hooks from the worktree copy, so edits there take effect and skill files stay readable
In a long chat, Muse sends your message sooner after you press Enter: the work before each request no longer repeats once for every installed skill, so it stays close to a fresh chat's

title.zh-TW: 支援企業憑證鏈、完整讀長行與並行觸發 Hook
title.en: Enterprise Certificate Chain Support, Full Long-Line Reads, and Parallel Hooks

body.zh-TW:
在企業網路代理環境、NFSv3 網路磁碟掛載，或閱讀壓縮成單一長行的資料檔時，先前常遇到遙測驗證失敗、重啟後歷史讀不到或長行被截半的狀況。現在用量遙測會信任 `telemetry.ca_bundle` 指定的憑證授權單位（簽發連線身分證明的機構）的憑證檔案。公司重新簽署 TLS 加密流量時，遙測也能依此確認連線可信並繼續運作；存在 NFSv3 掛載上的 `muse serve` 對話紀錄，重啟後仍可正常讀取。

讀取檔案裡的超長文字行時，只要在輸出上限內就會整行完整讀取，超過上限則提供位元組範圍指引。並行執行的工具呼叫現在能同步啟動各自的 hook（特定事件觸發的小程式）而不互相乾等，Muse Spark 1.3 開到 `max` 推理力度時也能取得與其他模型一致的完整回答風格與依據規範。
body.en:
Behind a corporate proxy, on an NFSv3 network mount, or when reading data files minified onto a single long line, telemetry verification used to fail, chat history could become unreadable after a restart, or long lines were cut short. Now usage telemetry trusts the certificate file of the certificate authority (an organization that issues connection identity certificates) specified in `telemetry.ca_bundle`. When a company re-signs TLS-encrypted traffic, telemetry can verify the connection and keep working, and `muse serve` chat history stored on an NFSv3 mount remains readable after a restart.

When reading extra-long text lines in a file, the full line is read as long as it fits within the output limit, with byte-range guidance provided if it exceeds the limit. Parallel tool calls now launch their own hooks simultaneously without waiting on each other, and Muse Spark 1.3 at `max` reasoning effort receives the same complete answer-style and grounding guidance as other models.

items.original:
Read long text lines in full when they fit the output limit, with byte-range guidance for larger lines
Usage telemetry now trusts the certificate authority file set in `telemetry.ca_bundle`, so it keeps working on networks that re-sign TLS traffic with a company root certificate
Muse Spark 1.3 at `max` reasoning effort now gets the same full base instructions as every other model and effort, including the newer answer-style and grounding guidance
Parallel tool calls start their hooks without waiting for each other
On a store kept on an NFSv3 mount, a chat's history in `muse serve` stays readable after a restart instead of being reported unavailable

title.zh-TW: 消除閒置 CPU 飆高，恢復長對話不再重開整排執行緒
title.en: Eliminate Idle CPU Spikes and Stop Spawning Threads on Long-Session Resume

body.zh-TW:
開著好幾個終端機視窗沒在操作、或跨版本同時跑著 Muse Code 時，以前風扇常會莫名其妙狂轉，恢復沒有檢查點的長工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）更得等螢幕一路狂捲舊歷史才開得起來。⟦猶如麵包店早晨開門只把新鮮出爐的那幾盤擺上檯面，不再把冷庫裡整批陳年麵團全搬出來，也不再反覆猛推早已上鎖的儲藏室門。⟧現在遇到日誌已消失的已結束子代理等無法讀取的背景任務，TUI 會停止每秒重試好幾次，閒置對話不再吃滿一顆 CPU 核心；新舊版並存時也不會再彼此反覆重建對方的已存工作階段清單。

恢復無檢查點的長對話不再為每個已結束 shell 指令各開一條背景執行緒，降低啟動工作量與記憶體隨指令史膨脹；恢復畫面也只顯示符合終端機回捲緩衝的最新段落並加註先前內容未顯示，不再讓整份歷史洗過螢幕。
body.en:
When several terminal windows sat idle or different versions of Muse Code ran side by side, fans used to spin up for no clear reason, and resuming a long session without a checkpoint meant waiting for old history to scroll across the screen. ⟦Bakers opening a shop at dawn put only the fresh trays on the counter rather than hauling out every batch of stale dough from the freezer or repeatedly shoving a locked pantry door.⟧ Now, when a background task can no longer be read—such as a finished subagent whose log is gone—the TUI stops retrying several times a second so idle sessions no longer peg a CPU core, and running old and new versions together no longer causes them to repeatedly rebuild each other's saved-session list.

Resuming a long session without a checkpoint no longer opens a separate background thread for every finished shell command, reducing startup work and keeping memory from growing with command history, and the resumed view displays only the newest portion that fits the terminal's scrollback buffer with a note that earlier conversation is not shown instead of flooding the screen with the entire history.

items.original:
When a background task's status can no longer be read (for example, a finished subagent whose session log is gone), the TUI stops retrying it several times a second, so an idle session no longer keeps a CPU core busy
Resuming a long session without a saved checkpoint no longer opens one background thread per finished shell command, so memory and startup work no longer grow with the session's command history
Resuming a long session no longer scrolls the whole history through the terminal; it shows the newest part that fits the terminal's scrollback, with a note that earlier conversation is not shown
An idle session no longer holds a CPU core while an older Muse Code version runs on the same machine; the two versions no longer keep rebuilding each other's saved-session list

title.zh-TW: 更新後重建清單與翻閱長對話不再整檔吃進記憶體
title.en: Lower Memory Use When Rebuilding Session Lists and Paging Long Chats

body.zh-TW:
每次程式剛更新完打開、或者工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）清單在背景重新掃描過去累積的龐大對話紀錄時，電腦記憶體先前常會瞬間暴衝。⟦猶如盤點厚重卷宗時改為逐行翻閱、一次只搬一箱進來核對，不再把所有大箱子同時攤開佔滿整張工作桌。⟧現在更新後重建工作階段清單不再同時讀取多個大型工作階段，有效壓低尖峰記憶體用量。

長時運行的對話在背景重新整理過去大型工作階段的索引時，包含沒有儲存檢查點的舊大型對話，佔用的記憶體都變得更少；往回翻頁瀏覽長對話保留的歷史紀錄時，也改成邊讀邊逐行解碼，不再先將整份日誌檔案一股腦塞進記憶體裡才開始解碼。
body.en:
Whenever you opened the app right after an update, or when the session list rescanned large accumulated chat logs in the background, memory usage used to spike. ⟦Auditors checking thick case files read them line by line and bring in one box at a time instead of spreading every heavy crate across the entire desk at once.⟧ Now rebuilding the session list after an update no longer reads multiple large sessions at the same time, cutting peak memory usage.

Long-running chats use less memory when refreshing the index of large past sessions in the background, including old large sessions without saved checkpoints, and paging back through a long session's retained history now decodes each line as it is read instead of loading the entire log file into memory first.

items.original:
Long-running sessions use less memory while the session list refreshes its index of large past sessions
Rebuilding the session list after an update uses much less peak memory, because large sessions are no longer read at the same time
Refreshing the session list's index of a large past session that has no checkpoint uses less memory
Paging through a long session's retained history no longer reads the whole file into memory before decoding it; each line is decoded as it is read

title.zh-TW: 重複模型指令只存一份，執行步驟也更省記憶體
title.en: Store Repeated Model Instructions Once and Slim Down Run Steps in Memory

body.zh-TW:
一個對話跑了上百個回合之後，每一輪其實都夾帶著一模一樣的模型指令與上下文設定，過去程式就像每回合都重新影印一份塞進記憶體裡。⟦好似班級發講義時把每堂課一模一樣的規則只貼一張在黑板旁，不再每一節課都重印一百份發進抽屜裡佔空間。⟧現在長對話不論是在運作過程中、還是恢復舊版程式錄下來的歷史紀錄，只要各回合或各次執行之間沒有變動的模型指令與上下文設定，記憶體裡都只保留一份。

紀錄裡的每一個執行步驟在記憶體中所佔空間也一併縮小，讓長時間進行的工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）更省資源。
body.en:
After a chat runs for hundreds of turns, every turn carries the exact same model instructions and context settings, and the app used to behave like it photocopied them into memory every single round. ⟦Teachers handing out class rules post one copy beside the chalkboard instead of photocopying a hundred identical sheets for every desk each period.⟧ Now, whether a long chat is actively running or resuming history recorded by an older version, model instructions and context settings that stay unchanged across turns or runs are kept in memory only once.

Each recorded run step also takes up less space in memory, making long-running sessions lighter on resources.

items.original:
Resuming a long session recorded by an older version uses less memory, because model instructions and context settings repeated on every run are kept once instead of once per run
A long session uses less memory as it runs, because model instructions and context settings that stay the same between turns are kept once instead of once per turn
Long sessions use less memory, because every recorded step of a run takes less space in memory

title.zh-TW: 去除工作階段日誌的雙重備份，降低恢復與成長記憶體
title.en: Remove Duplicate Session-Log Copies to Cut Resume and Growth Memory

body.zh-TW:
以前恢復一個長工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）或讓它持續往下聊，程式會在記憶體裡多留一整份重複副本，甚至為了驗證原始位元組而把每筆新舊日誌都存成雙份。現在從工作階段日誌讀回來的背景任務與子代理紀錄不再存兩份，沒有檢查點的長對話在載入時每一行日誌也不再同時保留兩份，大大降低恢復當下的尖峰記憶體。

無論是恢復載入還是後續新增寫入，日誌紀錄不再為了驗證原始位元組而額外保存第二份，供後續附加寫入使用的任務與執行狀態也不再複製對話裡早已持有的紀錄，讓長對話跑久了記憶體成長更緩慢。
body.en:
Previously, resuming a long session or continuing a conversation kept an extra duplicate copy in memory, even storing every old and new log record twice just to verify its original bytes. Now background-task and subagent records read back from the session log are no longer stored twice, and each line of a long session without a checkpoint is no longer held twice while loading, sharply reducing peak memory during resume.

For both resuming and subsequent writes, log records no longer keep a second copy to prove their original bytes, and the task and run state kept for later appends no longer duplicates records the session already holds, so memory grows more slowly over long chats.

items.original:
Resuming a long session uses less memory, because background-task and subagent records read back from the session log are no longer kept twice
Resuming a long session uses much less memory, because the session log's records are no longer kept a second time to prove their original bytes
Resuming a long session that has no saved checkpoint needs much less peak memory while it loads, because each line of the session log is no longer held twice
A resumed long session uses less memory, because the task and run state kept for later appends no longer copies records the session already holds
Long sessions grow more slowly in memory, because each new session record is no longer kept a second time to prove its original bytes

title.zh-TW: 減少日誌備用緩衝與磁碟刷新，加快批次開新對話
title.en: Trim Log Spare Buffers and Disk Flushes to Speed Up Batch Session Creation

body.zh-TW:
一次批次啟動大量新工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）或在長對話跑完重開時，以前內部會預留過寬的緩衝區、重複複製排隊訊息與事件索引，建檔時還頻繁刷寫磁碟。現在透過 `muse serve` 短時間湧入大量新工作階段請求時，寫入排程任務儲存區減少了磁碟刷新次數，建立速度更快。

恢復長對話時，即時日誌不再保留跟全部紀錄一樣大的多餘備用緩衝，供後續檢查點比對用的重播檢查也不再留存每則排隊訊息的副本；比對執行與核准事件副本的索引更改成每份只留一筆，讓長時間運行的記憶體維持輕巧。
body.en:
When launching a batch of new sessions at once or reopening a long chat, the internals used to reserve oversized spare buffers, duplicate queued messages and event indexes, and flush to disk frequently during creation. Now, when bursts of new session requests arrive through `muse serve`, writing to the scheduled-task store performs fewer disk flushes so creation finishes sooner.

When resuming a long chat, the live session log no longer holds an extra spare buffer sized for every record, and the replay check kept for later checkpoints no longer stores a copy of every queued message; the index that matches recorded copies of run and approval events also keeps each copy only once, keeping memory light during long runs.

items.original:
Creating a session writes its scheduled-task store with fewer disk flushes, so bursts of new sessions in `muse serve` finish sooner
Resuming a long session keeps less memory, because the live session log no longer holds a spare buffer sized for every record
A long session uses less memory, because the index that matches recorded copies of run and approval events keeps each copy once
A resumed session uses less memory, because the replay check it keeps for later checkpoints no longer holds a copy of every queued message

title.zh-TW: 已結束子代理對話讀後卸載，工作流程檢視縮減紀錄
title.en: Unload Finished Subagent Chats After Reading and Trim Workflow Views

body.zh-TW:
一場長工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）裡跑過好幾輪工作流程與幾十位子代理後，以前哪怕它們早早收工或失敗結束，整個對話內容依然硬生生卡在記憶體裡。⟦比方外包小隊結案後只留下工具與費用明細就退場，不再整隊人馬留在會議室裡佔位。⟧現在讀取已結束子代理的任務狀態，不會把整段對話一直留在記憶體中；已結束子代理的對話在最後讀取後會卸載，工作流程中失敗或未交結果的子代理，則在工作流程讀完其結局後卸載。

恢復長對話時子代理檢視不再另存一份所有歷史事件，工作流程檢視也改成只記下每位代理的工具呼叫與 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）用量，不再背著整段執行紀錄不放。
body.en:
After a long session ran multiple workflows and dozens of subagents, their entire conversations used to stay stuck in memory even after they finished or failed. ⟦Contractors wrapping up a project leave behind only the tool and expense breakdown when they walk out, rather than keeping the whole crew seated in the conference room.⟧ Now reading a finished subagent's task state no longer keeps its whole conversation in memory; finished subagent conversations are unloaded after they are last read, and subagents in a workflow that fail or end without a result are unloaded once the workflow reads their outcome.

When resuming a long chat, the subagent view no longer keeps its own copy of all past events, and the workflow view now records only each agent's tool calls and token (the text unit AI processes and bills by) usage instead of holding onto the entire run.

items.original:
Resuming a long session uses less memory, because the subagent view no longer keeps its own copy of every past event
Resuming a session with finished subagents uses less memory, because reading a subagent's task state no longer keeps that subagent's whole conversation loaded
Long sessions that run workflows use less memory, because a workflow subagent that fails or ends without a result no longer stays loaded after the workflow reads its outcome
Long sessions that run workflows or subagents use less memory, because the workflow view now keeps only each agent's tool calls and token usage instead of its whole run
Long sessions that run workflows or subagents use less memory, because a finished subagent's conversation is no longer kept loaded after it was last read

title.zh-TW: 大量指令輸出與執行紀錄由多份改存單份，省下重複記憶體
title.en: Keep Large Command Output and Run Events Once Instead of Multiple Copies

body.zh-TW:
跑編譯或測試指令吐出滿螢幕的結果、或開過一大堆子代理與工作流程時，以前同一段指令輸出竟然會在記憶體裡存成三份，已結束背景任務的最近輸出也存兩份。現在 Muse Code 把大量指令輸出從三份減為只留一份，已結束背景任務的最近輸出與恢復長對話裡保留的執行事件亦各只存一份（不再同時存在執行歷史與模型上下文檢視）。

工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位）開著且跑過子代理或工作流程時，沒用到第二份准入紀錄不再保留，每個小型任務紀錄清單也只維持實際使用的槽位不預佔空位，帶壓縮檢查點恢復的工作階段整體記憶體佔用也跟著下降。
body.en:
When build or test commands poured output across the screen, or after spawning many subagents and workflows, the same command output used to be stored three times in memory, and recent output from finished background tasks was stored twice. Now Muse Code cuts large command output from three copies down to one, and both recent output from finished background tasks and kept run events in resumed long chats are stored only once (instead of living in both the run history and the model context view).

While a session is open after running subagents or workflows, an unused second copy of their admission records is no longer kept, each small per-task record list keeps only the slots it actually uses without pre-allocating empty ones, and resumed sessions with compaction checkpoints use less overall memory.

items.original:
An open session that has run subagents or workflows uses less memory, because an unused second copy of their admission records is no longer kept
Resumed sessions with compaction checkpoints use less memory
A session that has run many subagents or workflows uses less memory, because each small per-task record list keeps only the slots it uses
Resumed long sessions use less memory, because each kept run event is stored once instead of once in the run history and again in the model context view
A session that runs commands with a lot of output uses less memory, because Muse Code now keeps each piece of command output once in memory instead of three times
Resuming a long session with many finished background tasks uses less memory, because each finished task's recent output lines are kept once instead of twice

title.zh-TW: 長時間運行的 `muse serve` 在對話離開後即時釋放記憶體
title.en: Long-running `muse serve` immediately frees memory after a session is left

body.zh-TW: 如果把 `muse serve` 當成常駐服務開著好幾天、陸續接待過幾十上百場工作階段（AI 對話的執行單位），以前即便用戶端早早離開，記憶體還是會隨著服務過的場數一路往上升。⟦想像車站寄物櫃在旅客取件後馬上把櫃門彈開歸零，閒置時站務員也不必一直巡櫃，整座車站才撐得住長久運轉。⟧現在一旦工作階段被離開或卸載，`muse serve` 就會把對應記憶體徹底釋放；每個已載入但閒置的工作階段消耗的 CPU 更低，就算同時掛著許多工作階段，新開對話的成本依然很輕。對單純重開的長對話而言，恢復過程的尖峰與後續開著掛在背景的常駐記憶體也一併壓低。
body.en: If `muse serve` stayed running as a persistent service for days, serving dozens or hundreds of sessions (units of AI conversation), memory used to keep climbing with the number of sessions served even when clients left early.⟦Train station lockers pop open and reset as soon as travelers pick up their items, and attendants no longer have to keep checking idle lockers, so the whole station can sustain long-term operation.⟧Now, as soon as a session is left or unloaded, `muse serve` fully frees its memory; each loaded but idle session consumes less CPU, and starting a new session stays lightweight even with many sessions loaded at once. For a long session that is simply resumed, both peak memory during recovery and resident memory while it stays open in the background are lowered as well.

items.original:
`muse serve` now frees a session's memory when the session is left or unloaded, so a long-running server no longer grows with every session it has served
Resuming a long session uses less peak memory
`muse serve` spends less CPU per loaded session while idle, and creating a session stays cheap with many sessions loaded
A resumed long session holds less memory while it stays open

entries: `session/read` shows which connected client currently drives a session (`driveHolder`, the holder's `initialize` name and version; absent when nobody live holds it)
A failed turn's error now carries `requestDenied: true` when the provider refused the request, so session protocol clients can show "Request denied" instead of a generic model failure
Permission profiles can now allow, prompt for, or deny Unix-socket access per path, and a refused Docker socket connection explains the sandbox block with the way out
Startup names the effective approval mode when `--yolo` was requested but a restrictive permission profile took effect

`session/read`, `session/list` and the `session/resume` result show which client last resumed a session over the wire (`resumedByClient`, the resuming connection's `initialize` name and version, recorded durably on the resume marker)
`session/resume` accepts an optional `modelId` that overrides the retained model for that resume — over a stamped label or pin — and recovers an otherwise-unresolved label binding
`session/start` accepts an optional `previousSessionId` that records which session the new one replaces, even when that session no longer exists
Settings-listed models can name a separate background model for reminders and reviews
When the approval judge escalates to you instead of deciding, the approval card now shows the judge's reason as one short line under the command, so a risky request is harder to approve by reflex

`session/list`, `session/read` and the `session/resume` result show which session opened a worker session (`spawnedBy`: the opening session's id plus optional project and thread labels, recorded once when the worker's first session starts)

`session/start` accepts an optional `spawnedBy` (the opening session's id plus optional project and thread labels); the host records it once as the new session's opener and serves it back as `spawnedBy` on `session/list`, `session/read` and `session/resume`

`muse session-message list --json` rows carry `spawnedBy`, the session that opened each listed worker session (its id plus optional project and thread labels), read from the same session index `session/list` serves
An older Muse build cannot open a chat whose permissions were reset because part of its saved permission history was lost or damaged; update the app to open it (other chats are unaffected)
`muse serve --preset` applies the preset's prompts and run settings, accepts presets defined with `-c`, and keeps the preset chosen at startup after login
New features in a project the agent built earlier in the same session no longer start with a failing test, and reported bugs still get a regression test

Inside tmux, Muse now reports its program status (OSC 7501) without waiting for the terminal to answer, so iTerm2's tmux integration (`tmux -CC`) shows whether a session is working, waiting for you, or done; a client that attaches later sees it once the attach resizes the window or the status next changes
Permission profiles that prompt before socket access keep prompting after a session is reopened, and opening such a session requires the latest app version
When an answer compares several things in a table, the detail that does not fit the table now comes as short paragraphs or list items instead of one long block per item
Resume checkpoints of long sessions no longer keep every finished Workflow's child-capacity records, so they stay smaller; opening a session compacted this way needs this app version or later
When Muse Code double-checks its work after giving a final answer, it now reports the result of the check in a sentence or two instead of repeating or extending the answer
Long `/goal` sessions that start sub-agents keep their resume checkpoints small and resume quickly, instead of carrying every step since the first sub-agent started
When you ask for a plan in a file and say what the chat reply should contain, Muse Code saves the plan and replies only as you asked
Overviews, explanations, comparisons, and answers in a format you asked for no longer open with a top-finding line; reports on work Muse Code did still lead with the main finding

When branching a conversation through `muse serve` fails because a session file could not be written, the error now names the step that failed, the kind of path and the operating-system error instead of only `WriteFailed`
`initialize` now refuses a `clientInfo.name` longer than 64 characters, with the same `invalidParams` error a malformed name already gets
Compaction checkpoints keep rejected commands in a smaller form; chats whose checkpoint holds one require a compatible app update, and older versions cannot open them
`/feedback` shows how big the session record is before you agree to attach it, and notes when it will be trimmed

The built-in `browser-game` skill builds games from long design documents with an art-director subagent, which makes the art and ships it in the game folder while the game is built, then runs three critic rounds that play and review the game; short game requests stay light
Apps that show tool activity now see a tool call while a pre-tool hook is still deciding on it, marked as held
When a task gives a reference image, the Blender skill now runs a required critic loop of blind reviews and fixes, as a workflow where available, so renders match the reference more closely
Models that support max reasoning effort now use it by default when you have not chosen an effort, including future models

Reopening a compacted session through `muse serve` (`session/read`, or `session/resume` when it returns inline or snapshot history) now shows the earlier conversation as one collapsed earlierHistory item holding the checkpoint's recent messages, followed by what came after, instead of replaying history from before the checkpoint. Clients that do not know the item kind show its fallback line
Security: Sandboxed Linux commands can no longer rewrite kernel helper settings under `/proc/sys`, even when Muse itself runs as root
A follow-up task sent to a subagent that finished before `muse serve` restarted no longer stops before reaching the model when MCP servers are configured
After a brief disk error interrupts one background save, the next save on the same chat clears it and goes through, instead of being refused until restart
A session waiting on a finished background task now wakes when the task finishes instead of staying stuck until you intervene

When a background context summary fails or is too large to use, Muse Code no longer pays for a new one every turn; it retries only after the conversation has grown well past the failed attempt, including after the session is reopened
Restore resume for older Side chats while preserving their history and permission settings
Preserve active tasks when compacting a conversation more than once
While a storage error lasts, a periodic save that has to be skipped no longer ends the turn when the note recording the skip cannot be written either; the error is logged and the turn goes on
Resuming a session saved by an older version no longer offers Workflow; start a new session to use it
`/new` or `/clear` right after cancelling a run no longer exits with a missing-file error
On Windows, sandboxed shell commands now start in the workspace when it is inside your user folder, so relative paths no longer resolve under the PowerShell install folder
On Windows, Ctrl+V pastes copied text into the prompt in consoles that pass the key to Muse, such as the classic PowerShell window, instead of reporting that no image could be attached
Forking a chat with `muse serve` on Linux works again instead of failing with "file birth time is unavailable"

The `game-3d-visuals` skill now stops its pipeline loop when you ask it to stop, open the file or change course: "open it" opens the file (or says it is not ready yet) instead of waiting for the running stage, and a comment such as "thanks" lets the pipeline continue
Fixed workflow instructions that did not match the current session
A sub-agent started from a `/goal` chat saves its history again when it compacts, so it can be resumed from that point
The built-in `python-env` skill tries a container image, conda channel or prebuilt wheels that the user or the project names before compiling a dependency from source

A chat in which one record of a turn could not be written to disk, even after a retry (for example on a full disk that stayed full), can be forked, side-chatted and rewound again; that turn is left out of the new chat, and Muse says so once
Resumed sessions with a recorded selection keep the model you selected instead of switching to a default
After resuming a compacted session, follow-ups and waits on a subagent no longer fail once a shell command ran after the compaction
Reopening a chat whose saved view fell behind, for example after a cancelled turn, shows its latest turn instead of an older one
A subagent's transcript that a restart cut off reads again as soon as its parent session resumes, with no action on the subagent
Sessions where an older Muse Code (1.4.5 or earlier) recovered an interrupted workflow save context checkpoints again, so compaction is no longer skipped or dropped in them

A forked chat whose saved history has an unreadable part, and where the start of one of its own turns could not be written to disk, no longer refuses every message after it is reopened, forked or side-chatted; that turn is left out, and Muse says so once
A session saves its history again when it compacts after a Workflow's agents were skipped or retried more than 128 times, so it can be resumed from that point
Background work status survives a restart after correcting a missing Workflow name
A session with a lost permission change now refuses to resume when its safe permission reset cannot be enforced, instead of opening with silently dropped Deny rules
A chat in the app or `muse serve` that was closed while a workflow was running saves its history again after it is reopened

When you tell the `game-3d-visuals` skill to stop or exit while its pipeline runs, it now also stops the running background stage (unless you ask it not to call any tools), and a stage that finishes after you stopped no longer starts the next one
Stopping a background task or Monitor from `/tasks` just as it finishes now records the stop right away instead of dropping it after a 30-second wait

A chat in which a reminder for one turn could not be written to disk, even after a retry, can be forked and side-chatted again; that turn is left out of the new chat, and Muse says so once. Rewinding such a chat is still refused
Rewinding past a message you sent while the agent was busy no longer leaves the new branch stuck refusing every message and showing that message as still queued
Resuming a compacted session with `tbh exec --session-id` keeps its subagents, so following up with, waiting on or checking a subagent no longer reports it missing
Keep unknown Workflow result references unchanged
Complete Workflow reports remain readable when their preview is shortened
MCP servers start again when you resume a session after it was compacted, instead of every turn failing with "MCP startup audit failed" or the MCP tools going missing

A forked chat whose copied checkpoint can no longer be replayed (written by an older build, or slightly damaged) opens, forks and side-chats again with its copied history rebuilt; only history that truly cannot be read is left out, and Muse says so once
A Workflow paused just as it finishes now stays paused, instead of also reporting a finished result after the pause
A deactivated Muse Code app now names the server reason instead of telling the user to log in again
`muse serve` refuses to reopen a session whose automated reviewer this host cannot prepare with the `permission_profile_reviewer_unavailable` reason instead of a generic internal error
A chat in which a reminder for one turn could not be written to disk, even after a retry, can be rewound again; that turn is left out of the new chat, and Muse says so once
When a full disk could not save a task link, a monitor line or, in most cases, a named workflow launch, compaction checkpoints now keep working without restarting the chat

Cancelling, force-sealing or stopping a subagent whose own background work is still being killed no longer reports it done early: the result arrives once that work has ended, a cancel that cannot finish yet fails with a typed error naming the task, a stop answers `stopping` until then and is recorded once the jobs are dead
After a resumed session, following up with a subagent started before the conversation was compacted works again instead of failing the subagent with a missing ownership error
A chat in which two different kinds of record could not be written to disk can be forked and side-chatted again; both turns are left out of the new chat, and Muse says so once for each
Restore native MP4 and MOV video reading for supported models
Sessions with an earlier video read keep working when the current model, provider or video setting can't send that video
A denied cross-origin redirect no longer replaces the stored session for an Agent plugin's MCP server, and redirect grants no longer match non-HTTP(S) origins
Reopening a session no longer fails when a turn after a compaction reuses rules or instructions from before it
Background task output now wakes a waiting session instead of staying queued until you intervene
Resuming a session whose worktree was deleted now recreates it on hosts without an enforceable creation sandbox when you already trust the source repository; untrusted repositories still refuse
Built-in skills the model loads on its own now name tools the way the model is offered them, so it calls them by the right name

A session started by another app now takes its title and first-prompt preview from the prompt as it was shown, not the app's wrapper text, so it no longer appears with raw JSON as its name; a session that starts with a skill or image is titled by its display form (its typed form, or [Image 1] for an image-only start)
Saved Workflows can run again from their local script paths on Windows
Agent no longer repeats a question you already answered in the same conversation
Keep recovery guidance intact in long background Workflow results
Preserve the specific failure reason when a subagent fails

A chat reopened on an older build, whose log saved two background-result notices at the same spot, keeps saving compaction checkpoints in the running process instead of refusing them until the next reopen

In the terminal app, resuming a chat whose saved history lost a record after your last permission change (without a permission flag) now reopens it with a reset to the narrower of the default and your surviving profile — or to `:read-only` when the two are crossed — and a warning, instead of refusing it; a resume with no safely-resettable profile is still refused
Resuming a `muse serve` session after Muse Code exited unexpectedly no longer shows the interrupted run's work as still in progress
After a session reopens from a compacted history, retrying an approval decision, a question answer or a queued-message removal returns the original result instead of handling it again

After a crash, `muse serve` no longer asks again about tool calls that were waiting for approval and no longer runs an approved call by itself; the interrupted calls are closed and a call the model makes again gets the normal permission check
Branching a conversation on Windows no longer fails with a write error
When more skills are installed than the startup skill list can show, the agent can still find the ones left out by looking one up with part of its name or description
